title: Model-Informed Drug Development for Antimicrobials: Translational PK and PK/PD Modeling to Predict an Efficacious Human Dose for Apramycin
locator: Results / Pharmacokinetics of apramycin in preclinical species, paragraph 1; Methods / PK modeling and prediction of human PK parameters, paragraphs 1 and 4
quote: For dogs, the data supported a two‐compartment model.
summary: Mouse, rat and guinea pig supported one compartment; dog supported two. Dog one-compartment parameters were nevertheless used for consistent scaling because CL and total volume were comparable. SC bioavailability was assumed; animal and human unbound fractions entered the method.
validation: First human trial was ongoing. The paper is a workflow example, not prospective human validation. Its human-binding input conflicts with a project withholding that input until validation.
data_availability: A supplementary PDF is listed; complete raw data not verified.
